risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantitative and identifies material COVID-19 impacts, including rent deferrals, tenant closures, increased vacancy, reduced capital spending, and a mortgage loan default. Liquidity is presented as strong, with $798.3 million of cash and no revolving-credit borrowings, but the outlook remains dependent on recovery in operating revenues and tenant payments. Extensive non-GAAP discussion and forward-looking language add some interpretive complexity but do not appear strongly evasive.
